data: First-gen LEO broadband — 648 sats in 12 polar planes
Eutelsat OneWeb commercial constellation. Public satellite count + orbital data from FCC + ITU filings.

First-generation LEO broadband constellation, 648 satellites at 1,200 km in 12 polar planes. Polar orbits give full pole-to-pole coverage that mid-inclination Starlink shells cannot reach. Acquired by Eutelsat in 2023 to form Eutelsat OneWeb; commercial service now bundled with Eutelsat GEO assets. Higher altitude than Starlink means slightly higher latency but fewer satellites needed.
Largest LEO broadband constellation — over 11,000 active satellites (as of October 2026)
Polar LEO comms — 66 operational sats +9 spares, GMDSS partner, global voice/data
Amazon LEO broadband — 3,236 sats planned, commercial beta 2026
Only operational MEO commercial broadband — 20+ sats
